text: Claim: all three sites were inspected. Source: inspectors visited each of the three listed sites.
Claim: the feature is available to every account. Source: only enterprise accounts have access.
Claim: the board deferred the decision. Source: the minutes say the decision was postponed to the next meeting.
Claim: the supplier caused the delay. Source: delivery was late, but the cause has not been established.
Claim: no customer data was removed. Source: twelve customer records were permanently deleted.
Claim: revenue will grow next year. Source: management hopes to grow but gives no verified outcome.
Claim: every customer is satisfied. Source: two customers gave positive feedback; no other survey results exist.
Claim: the report excludes licence costs. Source: licence fees are explicitly outside the report totals.
